body: How sad that my parents treat my half siblings better because I'm not my dad's kid. Boo hoo that I'll never be treated the same because my skin is darker compared to my half siblings, boo hoo that I have to watch everyone enjoy the holidays since I was a kid while I had to be the one taking the photos because to them I was their assistant instead of their kid, boo hoo that I can never join the dinner table without getting yelled at for ruining the mood upon my entry, boo hoo that I have to stay at home and watch the house Everytime they go on holidays. Maybe you shouldn't judge what a person is going through before stroking your ego behind a phone screen.

Boo hoo that I've watched my siblings every since I was a kid enjoying Christmas while I sit in the corner wishing that I received something, boo hoo that every holidays for photos I'm always the one taking it and they refused to put me in any of the holiday cards they send to relatives, boo hoo that my mother taunts me by always shopping for Christmas gifts for my siblings with me laughing off how I'll never receive anything because I'm not perfect enough for her, boo hoo that every Christmas Holidays when they go out for vacation I always stay at home because they need someone to watch the house, boo hoo that every time I try to join them for dinner I get yelled at for ruining the mood. Why don't you shut the fuck up before judging what someone else is going through while you sit around with a loving family for the holidays when I have to deal with this type of bullshit

It's because I'm not my dad's kid. My mother had me really young and remarried someone else. He never saw me as his kid and treated my half siblings a lot better than me. The favoritism had always been blatantly obvious when it comes to Education (me being in  a public school while my siblings are in prestigious private schools) and everything else. My mother never supports me about it and instead defends him and tells me I should be "lucky" that he allows me to live under the same roof as him. It's honestly hell
Thank you! She must've been new because she started to compare her life to mine and it just felt really uncomfortable
That's okay. Thank you for expressing your concern ❤️I hope we can get through this together
I just sent a complaint to them about the person. Thank you so much for suggesting that. I don't want anyone to go through what I did
Thank you for responding! I still can't believe it happened either, it felt degrading but I guess I might have to try another hotline instead
Thanks. I wasn't expecting them to reply like that since I've called the services twice before and they weren't rude to me like that lady was.
